parsed.internal_thinking: I have 3 VP and one revealed Knight. My hidden card is also a Knight. By playing it now, I will claim the Largest Army (2 VP), bringing my total to 5 VP, which is the win condition. I need to move the robber. Hex 14 (Wh9) has Bob on it; although I am also there, Bob is the one I want to target to secure the win without helping Alice too much, though she is also at 3 VP. I'll move it to Hex 14 and target Bob.
parsed.note_to_self: Playing Knight to reach 5 VP and win the game.
parsed.say_outloud: Alright Alice, you've been asking for a hero to move that robber. I'll take care of it and, more importantly, take the Largest Army for the win!
